prompt: I want the AlphaFold DB model of Calmodulin-1 (P0DP23) in the confidence (pLDDT) colouring; residues 71 to 85 should carry the tooltip 'residues 71-85'.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 1 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.6667)
equivalent answer succeeds: the binary file of the model, the flag in the load action, label numbers
wrong answer fails: the accession as molecule_id (not a PDB id: nothing loads) (F1 0.0)
